diff --git a/index.mjs b/index.mjs
index 4bff70b..49b5415 100644
--- a/index.mjs
+++ b/index.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export { slugify } from './lib/slug.mjs'
+export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
diff --git a/lib/slug.mjs b/lib/slug.mjs
index 30c170b..50c5ad0 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,36 @@
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  if (input == null) return ''
+  const str = String(input)
+    // Normalize to NFD to separate accents from chars
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    // Remove diacritics (accent marks)
+    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
+    // Lowercase
+    .toLowerCase()
+    // Replace non-alphanumeric chars with spaces/dashes - better: replace anything not letter/number with space
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    // Collapse multiple dashes
+    .replace(/-+/g, '-')
+    // Trim leading/trailing dashes
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+  return str
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(base, existing = []) {
+  if (!existing || existing.length === 0) {
+    return slugify(base)
+  }
+  const slug = slugify(base)
+  const set = new Set(existing)
+  if (!set.has(slug)) {
+    return slug
+  }
+  let i = 2
+  while (true) {
+    const candidate = `${slug}-${i}`
+    if (!set.has(candidate)) {
+      return candidate
+    }
+    i++
+  }
 }
